inbound.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "gateway-request", correlationId = (string)context.Variables["correlation-id"], method = context.Request.Method, path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path, api = context.Api != null ? context.Api.Name : string.Empty, product = context.Product != null ? context.Product.Name : string.Empty, subscriptionId = context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : string.Empty, requestId = context.RequestId.ToString() }; }

outbound.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "gateway-response", correlationId = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString()), statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode, reason = context.Response.StatusReason, backendUrl = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend-url", string.Empty), requestId = context.RequestId.ToString(), durationMs = context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds }; }

on-error.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "gateway-error", correlationId = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString()), requestId = context.RequestId.ToString(), message = context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Message : "Unknown error", reason = context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Reason : "gateway_failure", section = context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Section : string.Empty, path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path }; }

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Reason : "GatewayError"), new JProperty("message", context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Message : "The gateway could not process the request."), new JProperty("correlationId", (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString())), new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString()), new JProperty("backendUrl", (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend-url", string.Empty))))).ToString(); }
